overall_summary: While the channel is experimenting across various emotional themes, videos centered around 'self respect' and digital micro-behaviors (chats, blocking, statuses) have yielded higher view counts (averaging 25-40 views) compared to generic late-night sadness topics (averaging 5-15 views). However, due to the overall low sample size and low engagement (likes/comments), confidence is moderate-low, necessitating a continuation of the winning self-respect framework with a slight controlled exploration.

winning_patterns.pattern: Digital micro-behavior hooks tied to self-respect
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी' (AfaLxMy6FMY - 40 views) and 'स्टेटस लिस्ट में सबसे ऊपर उन्हीं का नाम था' (rwOUYo_hayQ - 37 views) outperformed generic sad themes.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on tangible, modern smartphone actions like muting, hiding stories, or removing pinned chats.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'रात के दो बजे' (G0gKV1p3ZHc - 12 views) and 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' (uIbMpCjVutQ - 5 views) underperformed significantly.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic openings about time or weather; ground the start in an immediate, recognizable phone-screen action.

next_video.concept: Removing someone from close friends or restricted story lists, realizing that hiding your peace is better than showing your pain.
next_video.opening_direction: Stories पर लॉक लगाने से पहले, मैंने उसे सिर्फ एक क्लिक में 'Close Friends' से बाहर कर दिया।
next_video.twist_direction: डर था कि वो पूछेगा क्यों, पर जब 24 घंटे बीतने पर भी उसका मैसेज नहीं आया, तब समझ आया कि मेरा डर ही सबसे बड़ा धोखा था।
next_video.reason: Leverages the proven high-performing 'self respect' topic and digital-boundary theme while testing story-view privacy as a fresh relatable detail.

experiment: Testing whether shifting from chat deletion to Instagram/WhatsApp story privacy settings increases comment/like engagement.
